title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
desc: A curious girl falls down a rabbit hole into a nonsensical world of talking rabbits, mad tea parties and a temperamental Queen of Hearts.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
desc: A Victorian scientist travels to the year 802,701 and discovers humanity split into two species — the gentle Eloi and the terrifying Morlocks.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
desc: Twelve cases for the world's first consulting detective, narrated by Dr. Watson — from 'A Scandal in Bohemia' to 'The Copper Beeches'.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
desc: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr. Darcy in Austen's sparkling comedy of manners, class and first impressions.
